verdict.rationale: ADK's first-party docs state that it automatically filters irrelevant events, summarizes older conversational turns, lazy-loads artifacts and tracks token usage. That covers the summarize and filter parts of keeping an agent inside its context window. The evidence is a single homepage-level claim with no configuration detail. Missing for 10: explicit history trimming/truncation controls, documentation of how developers configure or customize summarization and filtering, independent or hands-on corroboration.
